SELECT task_id, name, status, assignee, due_date, list_name, space_name, store_url
FROM clickup_tasks
WHERE COALESCE(LOWER(status), '') NOT IN ('done', 'closed', 'cancelled')
ORDER BY due_date ASC NULLS LAST;
